=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:295-303, 319-330, 570 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Unbounded Semble query text is read from disk and forwarded into `semble query` as an argv element, including the plan-text fallback at the call site.
  WHY: Large issue/plan payloads can exceed ARG_MAX and make Semble fail open for every overflowed file, silently degrading retrieval.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:329-337 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The regression test that pins the legacy non-Semble summary shape is missing.
  WHY: Without that test, the backward-compatibility contract for non-Semble output is no longer enforced in CI.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:497-503 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Semble-active summary undercounts `marker-only` because it uses `len(skipped_too_large)`, which excludes missing and binary entries.
  WHY: When missing/binary paths are mixed with Semble output, the parenthetical counts no longer sum to `included`.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:497-503 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The Semble-active summary always prints `0 marker-only` even when no overflow-marker entries exist.
  WHY: This adds noise relative to the legacy summary shape, though it does not change behavior.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:432-452 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: There is no test covering summary arithmetic when missing/binary entries and Semble-retrieved overflow entries appear in the same call.
  WHY: The accounting mismatch can regress without being caught by the existing tests.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:295-303 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The entire query file is loaded into memory and passed to `semble query` as a command-line argument with no length cap.
  WHY: Issue body, clarification answers, and full plan text can exceed ARG_MAX, causing every overflow retrieval to fail open to marker-only output.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:432-452 | confidence=3
